work.title: Readela 0.3.0: the popup shown whole at ordinary desktop sizes, and a check of Return when the saved passage lies in history the site has not loaded yet
work.ownerAuthorization: Owner instruction of 2026-10-13, after the owner's test of the local Chrome build on real ChatGPT and Claude conversations. It authorizes two bounded tasks on the existing branch, with commits and their plain push and without a check after each step: the smallest correction of the popup's layout so that it is shown whole, footer included, without vertical scrolling in ordinary desktop use; and a verification of Return for a passage in history the site has not loaded, with a correction only if a reproducible material defect is shown. It asks for updated local test builds and only the evidence the repository's workflow requires. It does not authorize a change of the typography, the reading themes, the reading options, the stored form of bookmarks, the permissions or the version number; support for code workspaces; a new control or a settings page; merging pull request 9, marking it ready, a tag, a release, a store submission or a change to Personal OS.

parentPreflight.reason: That record covers the fifth correction through its evidence and is not edited; none of its invalidators fired in the work it covered. The popup's layout is not in its scope, so this step is a separately bounded piece of work with its own assertion. What that record says about Return (never report as reached a place that is not the saved one) stays the contract a correction here would have to keep.

inScope: This record, committed first on the existing branch from baseCommit.

src/ui/popup.html and src/ui/popup.css, and src/ui/popup.js only where a text it shows has to change: width, vertical spacing and explanatory text that says a thing twice, so that the popup with its footer (Reset settings, By Amir42, the version) is shown without vertical scrolling at the browser's ordinary zoom; scrolling stays available where the room is unusually small or the text much enlarged. No control is added, removed, hidden or made smaller than is comfortable to use.
End-to-end checks of the popup's size in Chrome and Firefox, and a look at the rendered popup in both.

A check of Return on a synthetic conversation that at first holds only its latest messages and loads older ones in batches, some of them slowly, with a saved passage that appears only after several batches, one that never appears, and passages that repeat. Fixtures and end-to-end steps for it.
A correction of the search behind Return in src/page/reader.js only if that check shows a reproducible material defect, limited to that defect, with one regression test.
Documentation and dated evidence made necessary by the above, local Chrome and Firefox builds for the owner's review, and an accurate description of pull request 9.
outOfScope: The packaged fonts and how they are declared, the reading themes, the choices of direction, size and line spacing, the stored form of bookmarks, permissions, the version number.
More retries, a longer search or more scrolling without a defect that calls for them.
Code workspaces of the supported sites, a switch between chat and code, a settings page, any new control.
A repeat of the hour-long memory comparison, unless a change here affects what it measured.
The owner's browser profile, a signed-in site and real conversation content.
Merging pull request 9, marking it ready, a tag, a release, a store submission, store images and copy (ENT-243, paused), any write to Personal OS.
Capabilities, Exceptions, the dev-standards pin and the repository ruleset.
